answer: Bind each identity to one ferrous hardware key that signs every job and cannot be copied, so one key means one agent. A new key starts in a tundra tier: frozen to tiny, heavily audited trial jobs, and its privileges spiral upward only as those jobs verify, never by paying. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must buy 1,000 distinct keys at $35 each, $35,000, and pass 20,000 trial audits first. An honest agent just uses the key it already owns. If one key signs for two identities, that duplicate-signature collision freezes both and voids their pending payouts.
